reviewed_alert_notes.summary: Beach-area parking resurfacing is planned to begin Nov. 2. Consider the northeast side of the park and expect construction traffic near the cabins.
Through March 31, 2027, access is via the beach because Back Bay refuge’s interior trails are seasonally closed. The visitor center is also closed Mondays through Wednesdays during this period.
Public access is closed Nov. 2–3 and Nov. 16–17 for resource management.
Bridge replacement interrupts the route east of Farmville’s Main Street through Osborne Road during November, affecting access from downtown to High Bridge.
Bridge work closes the Holliday Lake Road approach from Highway 24 through Nov. 20. Use Hollywood Road for access.
Old Shawnee and Raider’s Run are now downhill biking routes only. Get the updated trail map from the park office.
The park is scheduled to close Nov. 9–11 and Dec. 7–9 for resource management. Dixon Landing’s boat ramp is also closed Nov. 1–5 for road work.
The park closes at sunset Nov. 3 and is scheduled to reopen at sunrise Nov. 6 for resource-management work.
The Potomac Heritage Trail is closed for maintenance. Seasonal hunting may occur nearby; follow posted signs and designated routes.
The park is scheduled to close Nov. 18–19 for resource management, with reopening planned for 9 a.m. Nov. 20.
Construction closes Marsh View Trail and its parking area. Drinking water and regular restrooms are unavailable; portable toilets are provided at the visitor center and picnic area.

Managed hunts close areas south of Beach Road Nov. 9–10 and the entire park Dec. 7–8. Permitted weekday archery hunting continues in designated areas through Jan. 1; those areas remain accessible to other visitors.
Renovation work closes part of western Kestrel Dell Trail. Follow trailhead notices for the affected section.
A resource-management closure runs from dusk Nov. 1 until the morning of Nov. 4.
Main-lot resurfacing is expected Nov. 5–6. Use the overflow lot or other designated parking.
Managed hunts close the park Nov. 2–3 and Nov. 9–10; overnight stays are restricted to hunters during those closures.
Sections of Legacy Loop are closed without a stated reopening date. Gordon Pond Spur provides an alternate route around the pond; follow local signs.
Maintenance closes Goodwin Lake Trail until Nov. 9.
Cabin and shoreline construction may limit parking capacity and beach access. DCR reports Big Meadow Trail, Fossil Beach and the day-use beach remain accessible.
